header: What the Praxis plan contains, line by line
lead: The full list behind the plan card. Each line says what this plan gives you, not just whether a feature exists.
note: Add-ons are priced separately and can be cancelled at the end of any billing period. Prices exclude VAT.

rows.title: Practitioner accounts
rows.text: A practitioner is anyone who can be booked into the appointment book.

rows.title: Reception accounts
rows.text: Free for everyone who books and checks in patients.

rows.title: Treatment addresses
rows.text: Each further address costs €25 per month.

rows.title: Appointment book
rows.text: Rooms and equipment are booked in the same view.

rows.title: Insurance billing
rows.text: Claims go out on the first working day of the month.

rows.title: Reminders
rows.text: Each SMS costs €0.08; email reminders are free.

rows.title: Recall list
rows.text: Patients who are due are listed at the start of each month.

rows.title: Printed recall letters
rows.text: Add-on. Our print partner handles printing and postage.

rows.title: Document storage
rows.text: More storage is €0.90 per GB per month.

rows.title: Data export
rows.text: Any time, without having to ask us.

rows.title: Support
rows.text: By phone and email, answered by our own team.

rows.title: Online booking for patients
rows.text: Add-on, cancellable at the end of any billing period.

rows.title: Single sign-on
rows.text: Not available in the Praxis plan.
